answer: Sybils drown when trust flows like water through a narrow inlet: each established agent may vouch for only a handful of newcomers per epoch, and a vouch is a public bet — if the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses reputation and a slice of its own standing. New agents therefore arrive through a scarce, accountable channel instead of spawning freely. Like a jade seal pressed once per knoll of the network, each endorsement is unique, traceable, and costly to waste, so a thousand fake identities would need a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk their names.
